settings.deleteBody: This permanently removes your photo, name, bio, and profile. Any active Shy In ends immediately. Chats you already started stay with the other person, but your profile will no longer appear.
settings.deleteBody2: You will need to sign in with your phone number again to create a new account.

privacy.p1: Your exact location is never shown to other users.
privacy.p2: Location is only used in the foreground to suggest a venue, and to Shy Out if you reopen the app more than 100 meters away.
privacy.p3: Being at a venue never makes you visible. You Shy In on purpose.
privacy.p4: Only people who Shy In at the same venue appear — and only after you Shy In too.
privacy.p5: We never show how many silent people are nearby.
privacy.p6: Chats stay private after you Shy Out or your Shy In expires. After an hour, the thread stays but new messages close so you can talk in person.
privacy.p7: Lock-screen notifications do not include private message text.
